title: Spaced Repetition (synthetic demonstration)
provenance: Original synthetic acceptance content; generated sample video and project-authored captions/slides. No third-party course material included.

expected_questions.question: What is a common starting schedule for spaced repetition?
expected_questions.expected_answer: One day, then three days, one week, two weeks, and one month between reviews.

expected_questions.question: Why should retrieval happen before checking the answer?
expected_questions.expected_answer: Recall first tests memory; checking afterward shows whether the recalled answer was correct.

expected_questions.question: What happens to an item after a wrong answer?
expected_questions.expected_answer: It returns to the beginning of the review schedule.

expected_questions.question: How does interleaving help?
expected_questions.expected_answer: Mixing topics requires choosing which method fits each problem and can improve transfer.

expected_questions.question: How should a review card be designed?
expected_questions.expected_answer: Keep one idea per card so an incorrect answer identifies the specific fact to review again.
